recent_posts.title: Real-time data, zero overhead: Stripe Database + next generation of Stripe Data Pipeline
recent_posts.summary: Stripe has announced two new products: Stripe Database and a next-generation Stripe Data Pipeline. Stripe Database is a managed Postgres database that automatically syncs all of a merchant's Stripe API data in real time (sub-1-second latency), providing a connection string developers can use directly in their apps without managing infrastructure. The next-gen Data Pipeline currently supports syncing to Google Sheets in real time via webhooks, with plans to add destinations like Snowflake and external Postgres databases. The project originated from an open-source Supabase integration that Stripe collaborated on and extended. Both products target the same core problem — getting Stripe data into the right place instantly — with the key difference being whether developers want Stripe to manage the database or pipe data into their own destination.

top_posts.title: Job Hunting Madness: Why can't I find a job?
top_posts.summary: The job market in 2024 is extremely competitive, with many applicants facing rejections and long application processes. Factors contributing to this include companies searching for 'unicorn' candidates, a saturated market, layoffs, and advancements in AI. Enhancing LinkedIn profiles, optimizing resumes, and considering freelance work are recommended strategies for job seekers. Despite the tough conditions, persistence and adaptation are key.

top_posts.title: All Machine Learning algorithms explained in 17 min
